info.title: OTK zk-Metering API
info.description:
REST API for the OTK zk-Metering runtime.

Provides receipt ingestion, ZK proof status, batch settlement, and observability endpoints.

**Auth model (E1.3 RBAC — ADR-0206):**
- When `OTK_TENANTS` is configured, bearer token auth is active. All protected endpoints enforce RBAC roles: `OWNER > ADMIN = OPERATOR > MEMBER > VIEWER`.
- When `OTK_TENANTS` is unset, all endpoints are open (backward-compatible). Admin endpoints may still require `x-admin-key` if `OTK_ADMIN_KEY` is set.
- `bearerAuth`: Required on receipt, accounting, and admin endpoints when auth is enabled.
- `adminKey` (`x-admin-key` header): Used on `/admin/*` endpoints only when auth is disabled and `OTK_ADMIN_KEY` is configured.
- `/admin/tenants/reload` and `/admin/finance`: platform operations. When auth is enabled no tenant role (OWNER included) may run them; they require the platform operator credential (`x-admin-key` = `OTK_ADMIN_KEY`). A reload that would load no valid entry is refused (400 `reload_would_disable_auth`). FINAL CLOSURE AUD-FC-01/02.

**Cost Units (CU):** Internal unit of metering cost. Deterministic, bigint-based, ZK-friendly. CU ≠ USD.

**Contract notes (H1-S24):**
- Versioning: every route also answers under `/v1/` (the prefix is cut once). Routes declared with a literal `/v1/` in the source are reachable at `/v1/v1/...` only. There is no version header; `GET /version` returns `apiVersion` (= `info.version`). With `OTK_STRICT_VERSIONING=1` unversioned paths are redirected to `/v1/...`: 301 for GET/HEAD, 308 for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE so that method and body are preserved (H1R2 S21-F03); infra routes, `/app` and `/system/status` exempt.
- Every response carries `x-request-id` (echo of the request header or a generated UUID); JSON error bodies and most JSON bodies repeat it as `requestId`.
- Error bodies: see `ErrorResponse` (envelope with `code` vs bare errors).
**Coverage (H1R2 C1):**
- Inventory of handlers: `scripts/ops/extract_routes.mjs` (it sees every handler since S08-F01 was fixed; committed in test/fixtures/security/route_surface_m1.json). Every handler of the API (routes.ts, SCIM, dashboard) and of the proxy gateway is documented here EXCEPT the entries of test/fixtures/contract/openapi_route_exceptions.json, each with its reason: public HTML pages and their trailing-slash aliases, the dashboard shell/login/logout pages, the changelog feed, the gateway `GET /health` (same path as the API `/health`; answers `{ ok, uptime, ts, mode }`), the internal ProverDaemon (port 3001, no authentication, NF-23) and two UNREACHABLE webhook handlers (`GET`/`POST /v1/v1/webhooks`, list/create: S21-F01, open). The API is therefore NOT fully documented; test/unit/h1r2_c1_openapi_route_coverage.test.ts keeps that list exact.
- Vendor extensions: `x-otk-permission` = RBAC permission checked for a tenant role (src/security/rbac.ts); `x-otk-platform: true` = platform operation (only the platform credential `x-admin-key` = OTK_ADMIN_KEY runs it with auth on; a tenant role, OWNER included, gets 403); `x-otk-tenant` = where the tenant acted on comes from (credential, path/body/query compared to the credential, or resource of another tenant answered as 404).
- Security alternatives that include `{}` mean the route is open when authentication is off (development A0; production refuses A0).
- Errors any route can answer (not repeated per operation): 413 OTK-4130 `body_too_large`, 503 OTK-5030 `request_timeout`, 500 OTK-5000 `internal_error` (also recorded as a dead letter), 503 bare `auth_not_configured` (production with authentication off, every route except /health, /healthz, /readyz and /version), 404 OTK-4040 for an unknown path, and 204 for an OPTIONS preflight (CORS).

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token identifying the caller tenant. Required when `OTK_TENANTS` is configured. Format of OTK_TENANTS: `tenantId:token,tenantId2:token2`.

adminKey.name: x-admin-key
adminKey.description: Admin key for privileged operations. Required when `OTK_ADMIN_KEY` is configured.

scimBearer.description: SCIM provisioning token: `Authorization: Bearer <OTK_SCIM_BEARER_TOKEN>` (constant-time comparison). Without OTK_SCIM_BEARER_TOKEN every SCIM request is refused (401, fail closed).

stripeSignature.name: stripe-signature
stripeSignature.description: Stripe webhook signature, verified with OTK_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

proxyBearer.description: OTK token on the proxy gateway (`Authorization: Bearer` or `x-otk-token`), resolved by the tenant registry / API keys (receipts:write for forwarding).

gitHead.description: Git commit SHA injected at deploy time via GIT_HEAD env var

total.description: Total receipt store attempts since startup

duplicates.description: Duplicate requestId attempts (idempotent, no side effects)

MetricsResponse.description: Runtime metrics snapshot. May include additional collector fields.

trackedKeys.description: Number of rate-limit keys currently tracked in the sliding window

requestId.description: Unique idempotency key for this receipt. Duplicate requestId returns 200 with duplicate=true and no side effects.

model.description: Model identifier used for the request

costUnits.description: Pre-computed Cost Units. If omitted, defaults to 0 (server may recompute).

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds. Defaults to server time if omitted.

userId.description: User identifier as bigint string (ZK circuit input). Defaults to '0'.

nonce.description: Anti-replay nonce as bigint string (ZK circuit input). Defaults to '0'.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier. Ignored when OTK_TENANTS auth is enabled (resolved from bearer token). Honored when auth is disabled.

costUnits.description: Cost Units recorded for this receipt

duplicate.description: true if requestId already existed (idempotent, no side effects)

ReceiptObject.description: Stored receipt with bigint fields serialized as strings

cwVersion.description: Cost Weights version active at ingestion time (ADR-0203)

proofStatus.description: ZK proof generation status. 'disabled' when ProverDaemon is unreachable or circuit breaker is open.

jobId.description: Proof job identifier (present when proof was dispatched)

proofAttempts.description: Number of proving attempts so far

nextRetryAt.description: Unix ms timestamp of next retry (when proofStatus=failed)

txHash.description: On-chain transaction hash (when proofStatus=proved and chain submission was configured)

epochId.description: Epoch identifier (e.g., week number or custom string)

totalCU.description: Total Cost Units accumulated for this (tenantId, epochId) — bigint as string

entryCount.description: Number of receipts contributing to this balance

root.description: Merkle root of the batch (hex string)

count.description: Number of receipts in the batch

epoch.description: Epoch of the batch — bigint as string

totalCUBucket.description: Total CU in the batch — bigint as string

flushed.description: Number of receipts included in the batch. 0 if no pending receipts.

chainHead.description: Current audit chain head (64-char hex keccak256 hash)

auditEntryCount.description: Total audit log entries since startup (or last restore)

hint.description: Usage hint when tenantId/epochId query params are absent

ErrorResponse.description: Error body. Two shapes coexist (H1-S24): the ENVELOPE written by sendError (src/api/errors.ts) carries `code` (OTK-xxxx), `message` and `requestId`; a BARE error written directly by a route carries only `ok`, `error`, `requestId` and sometimes `detail`. Clients must branch on `error` (stable machine string) and HTTP status; `code` is present only on envelope errors.

error.description: Machine-readable error string. Envelope (legacy strings of ERROR_REGISTRY): missing_required_fields, invalid_json, missing_header, invalid_parameter, unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, duplicate, idempotency_conflict, body_too_large, rate_limit_exceeded, too_many_auth_failures, internal_error, proof_error, unavailable, backpressure, spec_unavailable (some routes override it with a short text). Bare errors: metrics_unauthorized (STOPGATE-01 P1.2), registry_change_unsaved (STOPGATE-01 P1.1: tenant registry change applied on this replica, not yet in the shared registry; retry), registry_token_conflict (STOPGATE-01 P1.1: the token belongs to another tenant in the shared registry; not moved), registry_unavailable (STOPGATE-01 P1.1: shared registry did not answer before a token was bound; nothing changed), auth_not_configured, cross_tenant_forbidden, platform_operation_forbidden, email_not_verified, plan_upgrade_requires_platform, tenant_not_found, plan_version_conflict, plan_store_unavailable, redirect_not_allowed, tenant_context_required, reload_would_disable_auth, saml_not_supported, oidc_not_supported, gdpr_store_not_configured, proxy_auth_not_configured, quota_exceeded, key_revocation_failed (503: SCIM deprovisioning could not revoke the user keys durably; retry), subject_status_unavailable (503: tenant/user revocation state not confirmed by the shared store; applies on this replica, retry), webhook_management_disabled (501: listing/creating webhook endpoints is not enabled, S21-F01), user_store_unavailable (503: user store failed while checking the caller; nothing created), credential_status_unavailable (503 with Retry-After: the shared key store did not answer for a dynamic key, or the shared subject status store did not answer for a privileged or spending request; nothing was done, retry; H1R2 R-13/A3), export_source_unavailable (503: a receipt source of the export could not be read; nothing exported, retry), export_type_not_implemented (501: POST /data/export with a ?type= that has no export implementation), export_in_progress (409: an export job of the tenant is still running), export_capacity (503: too many export jobs on this replica).

code.description: OTK error code (envelope errors only). The first three digits equal the HTTP status.

message.description: Human-readable description of the code (envelope errors only).

requestId.description: Echo of the x-request-id header (generated when absent).

retryAfterMs.description: Milliseconds until rate limit resets (429 on the API)

loaded.description: Number of tenant entries successfully loaded from the reload string

authEnabled.description: true when at least one tenant was loaded (auth enforcement active)

get.description: Liveness probe. Returns server uptime. No auth required.
Returns API version string and git commit SHA (when GIT_HEAD env is set).
Snapshot of runtime metrics: receipt counters and additional observability data from the runtime collector.

401.description: Deployed environment without the scraper bearer (OTK_METRICS_TOKEN) or the platform credential (x-admin-key): metrics_unauthorized (STOPGATE-01 P1.2)

get.description: Returns the last N events emitted by the internal event dispatcher. With auth on (non-platform caller) it requires `receipts:read` and returns only the events of the caller tenant; key events (key ids, labels, roles) only to a role with `admin:keys` (PF-NEW-05, RV-RUNS-09). The platform credential and auth off see every event.

401.description: OTK-4010 `unauthorized` (auth on, no valid credential)

403.description: OTK-4030 `forbidden` (role lacks receipts:read)

get.description: Returns the number of rate-limit keys currently tracked in the sliding window.

post.summary: Echo ping
post.description: Echoes back the request body as a string. Useful for connectivity testing.

post.summary: Store metering receipt
post.description:
Stores a metering receipt and dispatches a ZK proof job. Idempotent by requestId: duplicate calls return 200 with `duplicate=true` and no side effects (no TAL debit, no proof dispatch).

**Auth:** Required when `OTK_TENANTS` is configured. The bearer token resolves the caller's tenantId. When auth is disabled, tenantId from the request body is honored.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Scoped to the caller tenant. Same key and same body within OTK_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_S (default 24 h): the first successful answer is replayed (same status and body, no new effect). Same key with a different body: 409 OTK-4091 idempotency_conflict. Only successful (200/201) answers are cached.

200.description: Receipt already existed (duplicate=true). No side effects.

400.description: Invalid request body (invalid JSON or missing required fields)

401.description: Unauthorized (when OTK_TENANTS is configured and token is missing or invalid)

403.description: Forbidden — insufficient RBAC permissions (role lacks receipts:write; e.g. VIEWER role)

409.description: OTK-4091 idempotency_conflict (Idempotency-Key reused with a different body) or OTK-4090 duplicate (requestId in use by another tenant)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (per-tenant) or too many auth failures

503.description: OTK-5030 unavailable: the receipt could not be durably written (not acknowledged)

get.description:
Retrieves a stored receipt and its ZK proof status. Cross-tenant reads are rejected with 403.

**Auth:** Required when `OTK_TENANTS` is configured.

401.description: Unauthorized

403.description: Forbidden — cross-tenant read attempt

get.description:
Returns the accumulated Cost Units for a given (tenantId, epochId) pair from the TokenAccountingLayer.

**Auth (E1.3):** Requires `accounting:read` permission when `OTK_TENANTS` is configured. Open when auth is disabled.

401.description: Unauthorized (token missing or invalid when auth is enabled)

403.description: Forbidden — insufficient RBAC permissions (role lacks accounting:read)

post.summary: Flush receipt batch
post.description:
Aggregates all pending receipts into a Merkle batch and submits it. Returns the batch header.

**Auth (E1.3):** When auth is enabled (`OTK_TENANTS`), requires `admin:flush` permission via bearer token (ADMIN/OPERATOR/OWNER roles). When auth is disabled, requires `x-admin-key` header if `OTK_ADMIN_KEY` is configured.

200.description: Batch flushed (flushed=0 if no pending receipts)

401.description: Unauthorized (token missing/invalid or x-admin-key wrong)

403.description: Forbidden — insufficient RBAC permissions (role lacks admin:flush)

get.description:
Returns the current audit chain head hash and total entry count. Useful for verifying audit chain integrity.

**Auth (E1.3):** When auth is enabled, requires `admin:chain-head` permission (ADMIN/OPERATOR/OWNER). When auth is disabled, requires `x-admin-key` if `OTK_ADMIN_KEY` is configured.

401.description: Unauthorized (token missing/invalid or x-admin-key wrong)

403.description: Forbidden — insufficient RBAC permissions (role lacks admin:chain-head)

get.description:
Returns a summary of the TokenAccountingLayer. Add `tenantId` and `epochId` query params to get a specific balance.

**Auth (E1.3):** When auth is enabled, requires `admin:tal-summary` permission (ADMIN/OPERATOR/OWNER). When auth is disabled, requires `x-admin-key` if `OTK_ADMIN_KEY` is configured.

401.description: Unauthorized (token missing/invalid or x-admin-key wrong)

403.description: Forbidden — insufficient RBAC permissions (role lacks admin:tal-summary)

get.description: Serves the canonical OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec for this API. No auth required. Spec is loaded from `docs/api/openapi.json` at runtime and cached in memory.

503.description: Spec file not found in runtime image

get.description: Serves a Redoc HTML page that renders the OpenAPI spec from `/openapi.json`. Intended for browser consumption. No auth required.

post.summary: Live tenant key rotation
post.description:
Reloads the TenantKeyRegistry from a new OTK_TENANTS-format string without restarting the process.

**Auth:** platform operation (replaces the registry of every tenant). When auth is enabled (`OTK_TENANTS`), requires the platform operator credential (`x-admin-key` = `OTK_ADMIN_KEY`); tenant roles, OWNER included, get 403 `platform_operation_forbidden` (FINAL CLOSURE AUD-FC-01). A reload with no valid entry is refused with 400 `reload_would_disable_auth` and the registry is unchanged. When auth is disabled, requires `x-admin-key` if `OTK_ADMIN_KEY` is configured. Added in E1.2.

tenants.description: OTK_TENANTS-format string: `tenantId:token,tenantId2:token2`. Empty string disables auth.

400.description: Invalid JSON or missing tenants field

401.description: Unauthorized (token missing/invalid or x-admin-key wrong)

403.description: Forbidden — platform operation: tenant roles (OWNER included) are denied without the platform operator credential.

post.summary: Assign a plan tier to a tenant
post.description: Assigns FREE, STARTER or PRO. **Auth:** the platform credential (`x-admin-key`) may assign any tier to any existing, active tenant; a tenant role with `admin:tenants` (OWNER, ADMIN) acts only on its own tenant and may keep or LOWER its tier (raising it needs the platform or the signed Stripe checkout; SEC02-N01). The decision and the write use the same plan version (H1-S01).

400.description: OTK-4002 invalid_json or OTK-4001 missing_required_fields

401.description: Unauthorized

403.description: `forbidden` (role lacks admin:tenants), `cross_tenant_forbidden` (tenant role on another tenant) or `plan_upgrade_requires_platform` (tenant role raising its own tier)

404.description: `tenant_not_found` (platform caller, tenant unknown or inactive). Body: { ok: false, error: 'tenant_not_found', tenantId }

409.description: `plan_version_conflict`: the plan changed concurrently between read and write; nothing was written; read again and retry

503.description: `plan_store_unavailable`: the plan store did not confirm the write; the change may not be applied; retry

post.summary: Create a Stripe checkout session for the caller tenant
post.description: Requires `admin:tenants` (OWNER, ADMIN) when auth is enabled. The session belongs to the tenant of the credential (a `tenantId` in the body is ignored). `successUrl` and `cancelUrl` must use an origin listed in `OTK_BILLING_REDIRECT_ORIGINS` (deployed environments with the list empty refuse every redirect; development accepts localhost only). H1-S03.

400.description: OTK-4002 invalid_json, OTK-4001 (missing fields / tier not STARTER or PRO), `redirect_not_allowed` (successUrl or cancelUrl outside OTK_BILLING_REDIRECT_ORIGINS) or `tenant_context_required` (auth on and the credential carries no tenant)

401.description: Unauthorized

403.description: Forbidden (role lacks admin:tenants)

get.description: H1R2 S21-F01: not enabled in this version. Every spelling (`/webhooks`, `/v1/webhooks`, `/v1/v1/webhooks`, trailing slash) authenticates first and then answers 501 `webhook_management_disabled`. Activation requires the SSRF destination policy (src/webhooks/destinationPolicy.ts) and the minimum-role decision M24-DYN-09 (PENDING_HUMAN_POLICY). Endpoints by id stay under `/v1/v1/webhooks/{id}`.

401.description: OTK-4010: no valid credential (auth enabled)

post.summary: Create a webhook endpoint (disabled)
post.description: H1R2 S21-F01: not enabled in this version (see GET). No endpoint is created; the body is not read.

401.description: OTK-4010: no valid credential (auth enabled)

post.summary: Stripe webhook receiver
post.description: Authenticated by the `Stripe-Signature` header (no OTK credential). An effect that was not persisted is NOT acknowledged: 503 with `received: false`, so Stripe redelivers (H1-S03, INF02-O2). Events are idempotent per event id.

200.description: Processed (or already processed): { received: true, result }

401.description: OTK-4010 with error 'invalid Stripe webhook signature'

500.description: OTK-5000: webhook secret or Stripe key not configured

503.description: `received: false`: the effect was not persisted (retryable); Stripe retries. Body: { received: false, result } (no `ok`/`error` fields)

post.summary: Create an API key for the caller tenant
post.description: Requires `admin:keys` (OWNER). A JWT that carries a user (signup/login) needs that user to exist, not be deprovisioned (401 otherwise) and have a verified e-mail (403 `email_not_verified`; H1-S05, SEC02-N03/N04). The key belongs to the tenant of the credential. The raw key is returned once.

201.description: Key created: { ok: true, key: { keyId, rawKey, prefix, tenantId, label, role, createdAt, expiresAt } }

400.description: OTK-4001 validation_failed

401.description: Unauthorized (also: user of the JWT missing or deprovisioned)

403.description: `forbidden` (role lacks admin:keys) or `email_not_verified` (verify the account e-mail with POST /verify-email first)

503.description: bare `user_store_unavailable`: the user store failed while checking the user of the JWT; nothing was created (fail closed)

get.summary: List the API keys of the caller tenant

200.description: { ok: true, keys: [...] } (metadata only, no raw key)

401.description: Unauthorized

403.description: Forbidden

post.summary: Rotate an API key of the caller tenant
post.description: Same gates as POST /keys (including 403 `email_not_verified`). A key of another tenant is answered as not found (404).

401.description: Unauthorized

403.description: `forbidden` or `email_not_verified`

404.description: OTK-4040 key not found (or of another tenant)

503.description: bare `user_store_unavailable`: the user store failed while checking the user of the JWT; nothing was created (fail closed)

get.summary: Invoice of the caller tenant for an epoch
get.description: Requires `accounting:read`. `tenantId` defaults to the caller; another tenant is refused (403 `cross_tenant_forbidden`).

200.description: { ok: true, invoice: { tenantId, epochId, totalCU, lineItems[], ... } }

401.description: Unauthorized

403.description: `forbidden` or `cross_tenant_forbidden`

get.summary: GDPR export of the caller tenant
get.description: Requires `admin:gdpr` (OWNER); only the caller's own tenant (403 `cross_tenant_forbidden`). JSON `{ tenant, receipts[], auditLog[], exportedAt }` or CSV with `?format=csv` (header `id,tenantId,userId,costUnits,timestamp,requestId`). Receipts = ALL the receipts of the tenant in the receipt store (memory + every PostgreSQL page) merged with the configured GDPR store, dedup by requestId; header `x-otk-export-sources` lists the sources read; read-only (H1R2 C2, S23-F02 fixed; before: only the GDPR store, never configured, so empty lists). `auditLog` comes from the GDPR store only (empty when none is configured).

401.description: Unauthorized

403.description: `forbidden` or `cross_tenant_forbidden`

503.description: `export_source_unavailable`: a configured receipt source (PostgreSQL) could not be read; nothing was exported (never a partial list)

delete.summary: GDPR erasure of the caller tenant
delete.description: Requires `admin:gdpr` (OWNER); only the caller's own tenant. Delegated to the configured GDPR store; every erasure is logged (`gdpr_erasure`). Without a configured GDPR store the request is refused with 501 `gdpr_store_not_configured` (H1-S23, S23-F01; before: 200 with erasedCount 0 and nothing erased).

200.description: { ok: true, tenantId, erasedCount, tombstoneHash, erasedAt }

401.description: Unauthorized

403.description: `forbidden` or `cross_tenant_forbidden`

post.summary: Legacy metering-event endpoint of the proxy gateway
post.description: Served by the PROXY GATEWAY (port OTK_PROXY_PORT, default 8788), not by the API. Same identity and permission rule as the MITM path: an OTK token with `receipts:write` (Bearer, or x-api-key). Authentication failures are counted per SOURCE (not per tenant): after OTK_PROXY_AUTH_FAIL_MAX (default 20) failures in OTK_PROXY_AUTH_FAIL_WINDOW_MS (default 60 s) the source gets 429 `too_many_auth_failures` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds) BEFORE any token is looked up, valid ones included (H1-S06, SEC02-N02). Errors here are bare: { ok: false, error }.

200.description: { ok: true, proxied: true, meteringHook: 'active', requestId, costUnits }

400.description: invalid_json, request_id_prefix_reserved or cu_not_computable

401.description: unauthorized

403.description: forbidden (token without receipts:write)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the source may authenticate again (only on too_many_auth_failures)

post.summary: Create a data export job for the caller tenant
post.description: Any authenticated credential (minimum role: pending product decision M24-DYN-08); the tenant is the credential's (query/body tenantId ignored). The job reads ALL the receipts of the tenant (receipt store memory + every PostgreSQL page, plus the GDPR store when configured), read-only. Poll `GET /data/export/status/{jobId}`. H1R2 C2 (S23-F03 fixed; before: the job always finished with `{ records: [], count: 0 }`).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Data type to export. Only `receipts` (default) is implemented; any other value answers 501 `export_type_not_implemented`.

503.description: `export_capacity`: too many export jobs kept on this replica; retry later (H1R2 review MED-3)

409.description: `export_in_progress`: an export job of this tenant is still running; the body carries its `jobId` (H1R2 review MED-3)

400.description: `invalid_parameter` (OTK-4004): format is not json or csv

401.description: Unauthorized

501.description: `export_type_not_implemented`: no export implementation for the requested type; no job is created

get.summary: Status of a data export job of the caller tenant
get.description: `{ jobId, status, tenantId, format }`; status `done` adds `data: { records[], count, scope: ['receipts'], notIncluded[], sources[], csv? }` and `completedAt`; status `failed` adds `error: 'export_source_unavailable'` (a receipt source could not be read; nothing exported). A job of another tenant is 404.

401.description: Unauthorized

404.description: `not_found`: unknown job or job of another tenant

get.description: With auth on a tenant gets its own trend only (`tenantId` defaults to the caller; another tenant → 403 cross_tenant_forbidden, AUD-FC-12); the platform credential may ask any tenant or all. Auth off: open.

401.description: OTK-4010 `unauthorized`: authentication is on and the credential is missing, invalid, revoked or of a deactivated tenant/user

403.description: bare `cross_tenant_forbidden`

get.description: Public: plan tiers and quotas (`cuQuotaPerEpoch` as a decimal string).

get.summary: Server-sent events of the caller tenant
get.description: SSE stream (`text/event-stream`) scoped to the tenant of the credential; the connection stays open. Requires `accounting:read` when auth is on.

401.description: OTK-4010 `unauthorized`: authentication is on and the credential is missing, invalid, revoked or of a deactivated tenant/user

403.description: OTK-4030 `forbidden`: the role lacks `accounting:read`

get.description: With auth on (non-platform caller) needs `receipts:read` and evaluates for the caller tenant only (`tenantId` of another tenant → 403, NF-21). Platform credential or auth off: any tenant.

400.description: OTK-4001: `key query param required`

401.description: OTK-4010 `unauthorized`: authentication is on and the credential is missing, invalid, revoked or of a deactivated tenant/user

403.description: OTK-4030 `forbidden` (role lacks `receipts:read`) or bare `cross_tenant_forbidden` (the tenant of the path/body/query differs from the tenant of the credential)

post.summary: Create a user, an organization (tenant) and an OWNER membership
post.description: Public. Sends a verification e-mail when an e-mail adapter is configured. Returns a JWT (OWNER of the new org, with `userId`) when OTK_JWT_SECRET is set. The account e-mail must be verified (POST /verify-email) before the JWT may create API keys (H1-S05).

400.description: OTK-4002 `invalid_json` or OTK-4001 validation error (`details` lists the issues)

post.summary: Log in with e-mail and password
post.description: Public. Unknown user, wrong password, deprovisioned user (SCIM) and deactivated tenant all answer the same 401 `invalid credentials` (same scrypt work, F-H1-09).

503.description: `credential_status_unavailable`: the organization/user status could not be confirmed by the shared status store; no token issued; retry (H1R2 review H3). A user without any organization membership gets 401 like a wrong password (H1R2 review H1; before: a JWT for tenant `default`).

400.description: OTK-4002 `invalid_json` or OTK-4001 validation error (`details` lists the issues)

401.description: OTK-4010: `invalid credentials`

Credentials in the query string are removed (R11). Admission with auth on: OTK token (401 `unauthorized`; the source is throttled after OTK_PROXY_AUTH_FAIL_MAX failures → 429 `too_many_auth_failures` with `Retry-After`), role permission (403 `forbidden`). Auth off: 503 `proxy_auth_not_configured` unless OTK_PROXY_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED=1 (development). Over the plan quota → 429 `quota_exceeded`. The upstream status and body are relayed otherwise.
